from pipeline import import_batch, resume
from reducer import empty_state
from checkpoint import dump_state
lines = [
 '{\"id\":\"r1\",\"op\":\"restock\",\"sku\":\"A\",\"qty\":10}',
 '{\"id\":\"r2\",\"op\":\"restock\",\"sku\":\"B\",\"qty\":5}',
 '{\"id\":\"v1\",\"op\":\"reserve\",\"request\":\"Q\",\"lines\":[[\"A\",3],[\"B\",2]]}',
 '{\"id\":\"c1\",\"op\":\"cancel\",\"request\":\"Q\"}',
 '{\"id\":\"v2\",\"op\":\"reserve\",\"request\":\"Q\",\"lines\":[[\"A\",4]]}',
]
unint = import_batch(empty_state(), lines)
final_cp = dump_state(unint)
allok = True
for split in range(0, len(lines)+1):
    part = import_batch(empty_state(), lines[:split])
    cp = dump_state(part)
    restarted = resume(cp, lines[split:])
    if restarted != final_cp:
        allok = False
        print('MISMATCH at split', split)
print('restart equiv all splits:', allok)
